sections.title: 1. Design Summary
sections.prompt: In 2–5 sentences: the chosen design, and why it meets every acceptance criterion and obligation without worsening any deferred impact.

fields.name: Touches
fields.prompt: Exact file paths and symbols, e.g. `src/a.py` (`parse`, `Config.load`)

fields.name: Behavior
fields.prompt: Expected behavior once the step is done, with no open choices

fields.name: Method
fields.prompt: Exact command or action, observable from outside the component

fields.name: Expected
fields.prompt: Observable result that means the check passes

fields.name: Verifies
fields.prompt: Criterion or obligation ids it verifies, e.g. AC1, O2, or "None"

fields.name: Claim
fields.prompt: What already holds, with no change needed

fields.name: Evidence
fields.prompt: File paths, symbols, or references that prove it

sections.title: 5. Traceability
sections.item_schema: <criterion or obligation id> — Met by: <step or certification ids> — Checks: <check ids>
